aspects.name: Territory and minimum purchases
justifications: Defines the Territory as France (mainland and Corsica) and Monaco, the area in which the Distributor is granted exclusivity.
Grants the Distributor exclusive distribution rights in the Territory, with the Manufacturer barred from appointing other dealers or supplying customers there directly.
Limits the Distributor's sales outside the Territory, prohibiting active sales, advertising and branches there while allowing unsolicited orders.
Sets the minimum purchase quantity of 120 pumps per calendar year, excluding spare parts.
Credits the initial stocking order toward the minimum purchase quantity for 2027.
Specifies the consequence of a minimum purchase shortfall: the Manufacturer may withdraw exclusivity on three months' notice, with no other rights.
Confirms that the Territory is the Vertragsgebiet defined in Section 2.1 of the Contract, for the purposes of the amendment.
Amendment extends the Territory to Belgium from 1 January 2028 with exclusivity, and permits active non-exclusive sales in Luxembourg, which is excluded from the Territory.
Amendment reduces the 2028 minimum purchase quantity by 25%, counts Belgian and Luxembourg products toward it, and keeps the original minimum for later years.

aspects.name: Delivery and transport risk
justifications: Sets the delivery term as FCA Lindenfurt plant (Incoterms 2020), with the Distributor appointing the carrier and bearing transport costs from the works.
Passes the risk of loss and deterioration to the Distributor on handover to its carrier at the Lindenfurt plant.
Sets delivery periods from order confirmation, allows partial deliveries, and gives withdrawal rights for delay.
Annex specifies FCA Lindenfurt delivery and lead times of 6 weeks for HP-200 and HP-350 and 10 weeks for HP-500.
Amendment replaces the delivery term with DAP the Distributor's warehouse in Bellerive-sur-Erdre from 1 March 2028, with transport costs borne by the Manufacturer.
Amendment moves the risk transfer to the moment goods are made available at the Distributor's warehouse, ready for unloading, with unloading at the Distributor's cost and risk.

aspects.name: Prices and payment
justifications: Sets the list prices under Annex 1, stated net plus VAT and including standard packaging.
States the list price of an HP-350 pump as EUR 7,150 net per unit at contract signing.
Grants an 8% one-time introductory discount on list prices for the initial stocking order, with no other discounts.
Permits list price adjustments from 1 January 2028, at most once per year, capped at 4% with three months' notice.
Sets invoicing on the date of risk transfer, with electronic delivery of invoices.
Sets payment at 30 days net and a 2% early-payment discount for payment within 10 days.
Rule of precedence: the German text prevails over Annex 1 in conflicts, except that Annex 1 governs technical data and list prices, even where Annex 1 provides otherwise.
Annex states that it prevails over the Agreement in case of inconsistency, which bears on the rules deciding between the German agreement and Annex 1.
Annex specifies the initial stocking order quantities and its invoicing date of 15 March 2027.
Annex sets payment terms of 45 days net and a 2% early-payment discount within 10 days, which conflicts with the 30-day term in the Agreement.
Amendment reduces the minimum purchase quantity, but this does not directly change pricing; excluded from this aspect.

aspects.name: Warranty and product performance
justifications: Requires immediate inspection of goods and written notice of obvious defects within eight working days and hidden defects within eight working days of discovery, otherwise deemed approved.
Sets the warranty period for the Contract Products at 24 months from risk transfer.
Sets a twelve-month warranty period for Wear Parts, which are defined in Annex 1.
Guarantees the technical data of the pumps at risk transfer and states a guaranteed minimum efficiency of 78% at best point for HP-500.
Sets remedies for defects: subsequent performance at the Manufacturer's choice, withdrawal or price reduction after two failed attempts, and the Manufacturer bears the costs.
Requires the Manufacturer to hold spare parts for the scope and duration set out in Annex 1.
Rule of precedence between the German Agreement and Annex 1: German text prevails generally, but Annex 1 governs technical data.
Annex states that it prevails over the Agreement in case of inconsistency, relevant to the precedence rules between the German agreement and Annex 1.
Defines guaranteed minimum efficiency values at best efficiency point, verified by factory acceptance test under ISO 9906.
Defines Wear Parts as mechanical seals, O-rings, wear rings and bearing bushes, excluding impellers, shafts and casings.
Annex commits the Manufacturer to supply spare parts for 10 years after end of series production, with stock dispatched within 5 working days.

concepts.name: Amendment No. 1 effective date
justifications: Article 7 states the amendment enters into force on the date of signature by the last of the Parties. The Lindenfurt signature dated 19 November 2027 is later than the Bellerive-sur-Erdre signature of 12 November 2027.

concepts.name: Changes made by Amendment No. 1
predicted: amendment no. 1 extends the territory to belgium from 1 january 2028, permits non-exclusive active sales in luxembourg, reduces the 2028 minimum purchase quantity by 25%, and from 1 march 2028 replaces the fca delivery terms with dap delivery to the distributor's warehouse in bellerive-sur-erdre with risk transferring on arrival.
gold: from 1 january 2028 it adds belgium to the exclusive territory and allows non-exclusive sales in luxembourg, it reduces the 2028 minimum purchase quantity by 25 %, and for deliveries from 1 march 2028 it replaces fca lindenfurt with dap delivery to the distributor's bellerive-sur-erdre warehouse, where the risk then passes.
values: Amendment No. 1 extends the Territory to Belgium from 1 January 2028, permits non-exclusive active sales in Luxembourg, reduces the 2028 minimum purchase quantity by 25%, and from 1 March 2028 replaces the FCA delivery terms with DAP delivery to the Distributor's warehouse in Bellerive-sur-Erdre with risk transferring on arrival.
justifications: The amendment's articles 2 to 5 set out the territorial, minimum purchase, delivery and risk transfer changes. These are the substantive modifications to the agreement.

concepts.name: Governing law and jurisdiction
predicted: german law (bundesrepublik deutschland), excluding the cisg; exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of lindenfurt for all disputes arising from or in connection with the agreement.
gold: german law, excluding the cisg; the courts of lindenfurt have exclusive jurisdiction.
values: German law (Bundesrepublik Deutschland), excluding the CISG; exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Lindenfurt for all disputes arising from or in connection with the agreement.
justifications: Section 8.1 selects German law and excludes the CISG. Section 8.2 designates Lindenfurt as the exclusive place of jurisdiction.

concepts.name: Prevailing text between the agreement and Annex 1
predicted: the german agreement text prevails over annex 1, except for technical data and list prices, for which annex 1 prevails, even if annex 1 states otherwise.
gold: the german agreement prevails, except for technical data and list prices, for which annex 1 prevails.
values: The German agreement text prevails over Annex 1, except for technical data and list prices, for which Annex 1 prevails, even if Annex 1 states otherwise.
justifications: Section 9.3 gives precedence to the German contract text in conflicts with Annex 1. It carves out technical data and list prices, where Annex 1 governs.

concepts.name: HP-700 is a Contract Product
justifications: The HP-700 series is listed only for information and is not a Contract Product unless added by a written amendment under Section 9.1. The amendment only provides for examining its addition in 2028 by a separate amendment, so it has not been added.

single-stage split-case pump for water and glycol mixtures
two-stage high-pressure pump for boiler feed and process water

gold.description: single-stage end-suction centrifugal pump for clean water
single-stage split-case pump for water and glycol mixtures
two-stage high-pressure pump for boiler feed and process water

values.description: Single-stage end-suction centrifugal pump for clean water
Single-stage split-case pump for water and glycol mixtures
Two-stage high-pressure pump for boiler feed and process water

justifications: Table 1.1 of Annex 1 lists HP-200 as a Contract Product with a list price of EUR 4,850 net per unit. Annex 1 governs list prices under Section 9.3.

Table 1.1 of Annex 1 lists HP-350 as a Contract Product with a list price of EUR 7,250 net per unit. Annex 1 governs list prices under Section 9.3, so this prevails over the EUR 7,150 figure in Section 4.2.
Table 1.1 of Annex 1 lists HP-500 as a Contract Product with a list price of EUR 11,400 net per unit. Annex 1 governs list prices under Section 9.3.

concepts.name: Countries of the exclusive territory in 2028
justifications: The amendment extends exclusivity to Belgium from 1 January 2028, on top of the original exclusive territory of France and Monaco. Luxembourg is excluded because the Distributor may sell there only non-exclusively.

concepts.name: Minimum purchase quantity for 2028 in pumps
justifications: The original minimum of 120 pumps per year is reduced by 25% for calendar year 2028, giving 90 pumps.

concepts.name: Consequence of a minimum purchase shortfall
predicted: if the distributor falls short of the minimum purchase quantity for a calendar year, the manufacturer may revoke the exclusivity by written notice with three months' notice, after which the contract continues as a non-exclusive distribution agreement, but the manufacturer has no other rights or claims for the shortfall, such as damages or termination.
gold: the manufacturer may revoke the distributor's exclusivity by written notice with three months' notice, the agreement continuing as a non-exclusive one; it has no other rights or claims for the shortfall, such as damages or termination.
values: If the Distributor falls short of the minimum purchase quantity for a calendar year, the Manufacturer may revoke the exclusivity by written notice with three months' notice, after which the contract continues as a non-exclusive distribution agreement, but the Manufacturer has no other rights or claims for the shortfall, such as damages or termination.
justifications: The clause allows exclusivity revocation with three months' written notice and expressly excludes other remedies such as damages or termination.

concepts.name: Incoterm of a delivery on 12 April 2028
justifications: Article 4 replaces the FCA delivery terms with DAP for all deliveries made from 1 March 2028, so a delivery on 12 April 2028 falls under DAP (Incoterms 2020).

concepts.name: Passing of the transport risk
predicted: for deliveries under the original fca lindenfurt terms, risk passes to the distributor when the goods are handed over to the carrier it nominated at the lindenfurt plant. for deliveries from 1 march 2028 under dap terms, risk passes to the distributor when the goods are made available at its bellerive-sur-erdre warehouse on the arriving transport vehicle, ready for unloading.
gold: for deliveries before 1 march 2028 the risk passes to the distributor when the goods are handed to its carrier at the lindenfurt plant (fca); for deliveries from 1 march 2028 the manufacturer bears it until the goods are made available, ready for unloading, at the distributor's warehouse in bellerive-sur-erdre (dap).
values: For deliveries under the original FCA Lindenfurt terms, risk passes to the Distributor when the goods are handed over to the carrier it nominated at the Lindenfurt plant. For deliveries from 1 March 2028 under DAP terms, risk passes to the Distributor when the goods are made available at its Bellerive-sur-Erdre warehouse on the arriving transport vehicle, ready for unloading.
justifications: Section 5.2 places risk on handover to the Distributor's nominated carrier at Lindenfurt, while Article 5 derogates from that for later deliveries and shifts risk to the moment goods are placed at the Distributor's warehouse. The Distributor bears the unloading costs and risks.

concepts.name: Net value of the initial stocking order in EUR
Payment due date of the initial stocking order invoice
justifications: The initial stocking order is invoiced on 15 March 2027, and the annex's payment terms of 45 days net from the invoice date (not counting the invoice day) make 29 April 2027 the last day of payment. The annex prevails over the general agreement's 30-day term.

concepts.name: Guaranteed minimum efficiency of HP-500 at BEP in %
justifications: The Manufacturer guarantees that the HP-500 series efficiency at the best efficiency point is at least 78%. This guarantee applies from the passing of risk.

concepts.name: Warranty period of a mechanical seal in months
justifications: Mechanical seals are listed as Wear Parts, which have a warranty period of twelve months from the passing of risk instead of the general 24 months.

concepts.name: Spare parts supply period
predicted: the manufacturer must supply spare parts for each contract product series for 10 years after the end of its series production.
gold: for 10 years after the end of the series production of each contract product series.
values: The Manufacturer must supply spare parts for each Contract Product series for 10 years after the end of its series production.
justifications: The annex specifies a supply period of 10 years after series production ends for each Contract Product series. The main agreement defers the scope and duration of spare parts availability to this annex.
